body:
> **Replay of [niway-dev/kaipu-record#276](https://github.com/niway-dev/kaipu-record/pull/276), run 2** for the code-review benchmark. Same base and head commits as the round-1 replay (a second branch name on the same commit, so the reviewer sees a fresh pull request). Never merged. Method: [wachiman/docs/benchmark](https://github.com/niway-dev/wachiman/tree/main/docs/benchmark).

---

## Summary

Remediation for audit findings F-1 (quota released while a presigned upload ticket can still write), F-2 (legacy `/api/v1/recordings` upload flow with no v2 controls and no callers) and F-9 (unvalidated asset-list cursor).

Design spec: `apps/documentation/src/content/docs/specs/2026-10-12-api-upload-abuse.md`

## State of this branch

- `f34df72` — WIP from an interrupted implementation agent (ticket-window deferral in cancel/delete/retry, legacy upload routes removed, cursor schema). Its message says `bun run verify` was not run; it was run on this commit in a clean worktree on 2026-10-12 and exited 0, but the work has not been reviewed.
- `f91b56d` — the design spec: current vs target behavior, design per finding with alternatives, interaction with NIW2-328 (scheduled jobs), test plan, acceptance criteria, rollout/backout, and an implementation-status section listing what the WIP already does and the remaining tasks in order.

## Open questions (from the spec)

1. Accept the pending-slot lockout during the ticket window (up to 3 h 05 min after a deferred cancel), or add a `cancelled` revision status?
2. Ship order with NIW2-328: deferred cancels/deletes only settle once the scheduled handler exists.
3. Orphan-object sweep: confirm it is designed here and scheduled in NIW2-328, and that legacy `recording` keys are treated as backed until cloud-01 Task 12.
4. Remove the remaining legacy read/delete routes now, or at Task 12 as planned (the web `/recordings` page uses them)?

Refs: NIW2-323
